events.text: Reading item 1: the ADU application form.
Found application-form.pdf in the packet. It is classified as the application.
Owner: [OWNER_1]. Project: detached ADU behind the main house at [ADDRESS_1].
Reading item 2: the site plan.
No site plan found in the packet.
A site plan usually comes from your designer. Ask them for one that shows the existing house, the new ADU and the distances to the property lines.
Reading item 3: the floor plan and elevations.
Found floor-plan-v2.pdf.
Reading item 4: sewer capacity verification.
It is unknown whether this sign-off must come before submittal. Ask the city.
Reading item 5: the water meter location.
This needs the site plan, which is missing.
Reading item 6: the new address request.
Please assign a new address to the proposed ADU at [ADDRESS_1].
Request drafted. It is not filed until you send it.
Reading item 7: the JADU covenant.
The packet doesn't say whether this is a JADU. If it isn't, this item does not apply.
Reading item 8: the statute reference.
Law Lens: this line cites Gov Code 65852.2 and 65852.22. SB 477 (2024) moved ADU law to Gov Code 66310 to 66342. A specific replacement section is not shown because none is confirmed yet.
Ask the city whether an updated checklist that uses the current section numbers is available.
Reading item 9: the owner liability affidavit.
Found hold-harmless-signed.pdf.
Reading item 10: the school district fee form.
IMG_2041.jpg could not be classified. It may be this form. Please check it.
